title: Motion values file
description: Each weapon type's attacks and their hits' motion values: the percentage of the weapon's raw attack a hit deals before sharpness and hitzones. The values are game_task's Blademaster attack table (packages/mhfu-extract/src/tables/motion-values.ts); which rows make up which move is hand-made (src/overlay/weapon-moves.json). The bowgun shots are game_task's shot tables (src/tables/shots.ts).

demon_mode_multiplier.description: Dual Blades' motion values in Demon Mode are this times their own, truncated

weapons.description: By weapon type (the site's slug), each type's moves in the site's order

bowgun_shot_multiplier.description: A bowgun's shots deal this times their physical damage

shots.description: The bowgun ammo that deals damage through the shot hitzone, by shot ID, with what Crag and Clust S burst into

shot.description: The game's shot ID: the ammo's bit in the weapons' ammo lists

ammo.description: The ammo's name, as the weapons' ammo lists give it

motion_value.description: The shot's power before true attack / 100 scales it

hits.description: How many times it hits: a pierce shot's hits, Pellet S's pellets

attack_scaled.description: True attack / 100 scales the value, as it does the motion value

explosion.description: What it bursts into after it hits (Crag S's explosion, Clust S's bomblets): fixed damage whatever the shot hitzone, without the bowgun multiplier, plus its element on that element's hitzone

power.description: Its damage, or with attack_scaled a motion value that true attack / 100 scales

hits.description: How many there are: Clust S's bomblets

move.description: The move's key; the site names it

demon.description: A Dual Blades move done only in Demon Mode

hitzone_weights.description: The percentages the move's hits weigh a monster part's cut and impact hitzones by; the larger of the two weighted values is the hitzone the hit uses

glow_hitzone_weights.description: Long Sword: the move's hitzone weights while the spirit gauge glows

charge_hitzone_weights.description: Lance: the charge's hitzone weights once it runs at full speed

row.description: The row of game_task's attack table (an attack's +0x0D)

demon_mode.description: Dual Blades only: the motion value in Demon Mode

count.description: How many times the move deals this hit

blade.description: Dual Blades only: the blade the hit strikes with, which carries a dual-element weapon's first or second element
